data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haeckel total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_greek.name: Ἁεκκέλ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Hebrew חיקל (Haykil) meaning 'Where is your voice?'. In Greek, this name is translated as 'Sacker', 'Harvester', or 'Reaper'.

in_latin.name: Haecelus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Greek ἅγκκέλ (Haekkel), meaning 'Sacker', 'Harvester', or 'Reaper'.
